reviews.title: A good balanced game
reviews.text:
Other reviewers suggested that you do not need to spend money to progress. That’s true. It’s all about time really. I myself have invested around $50 in the game. Getting to higher VIP level and some monthly gem club membership. 
I know people who spent $0 and we both started at the same time. I’m much more advanced then he is for $50.
 On a scale of 1-10....1 being a team of only lvl 100 characters and 10 being a team consisting of 250+ lvls, I would rate myself at 5-6. 
So time, I’ll try to put it in perspective. If you spend $0 and want to be around 9-10 You would have to play for 4-5 years non stop. I’m not kidding. But if you spent $1k you could achieve that in one month. 
So fun game but...It’s all about time.

reviews.title: I enjoyed the game, but...
reviews.text: The devs have made a VERY hard shift towards an extreme pay-to-win attitude. The price of the packages have always been RIDICULOUS ($100 USD for what equates to a a few summons, which are random, and maybe one specific hero), but their Valentine event that is currently running is what prompted me to give this rating. It’s such a blatant cash grab, with the worst rewards for the price I’ve ever seen in a gacha game. The server I play on has been losing people at a very steady pace, because the game offers so little to keep you playing (there’s literally no story at all, not even a single backstory for any of the heroes), but expects you to shell out a bunch of cash, and people get sick of the grind with no reward. There are many way better games in the same vein (play Final Fantasy Brave Exvius imo). I don’t see this game lasting without some changes.

reviews.text: I’ve been a daily player for over a year now and I love it! Can’t put it down. Thank you for making this game for me. Well thought of DH! Thanks for taking all my free time and spare money lol! But it’s definitely worth being addicted too!

reviews.title: Best gacha game I’ve played
reviews.text:
As someone who has played most major gacha games on the market, this one is probably the best. Idle Heroes has a solid progression system, satisfying incremental mechanics, and great team building, all while being f2p friendly for those so inclined. 

There is a ton of content, and there are always new goals to work towards. PvE and PvP are both fun and rewarding. Animations aren’t minute-long unskippable cutscenes, but character models are still great. 

The game is very addicting almost immediately. Highly recommended for anyone into idle/gacha games but doesn’t want to play a waifu collector.

reviews.text:

If the game were a bit easier to progress through the higher levels it would be so much better. Don’t get me wrong, I like a challenge but this is ridiculous being stuck on the same stage for days at a time because I have no choice to wait for hero upgrade stones. Which are BY FAR the most important and hardest to come by items in the game. I get 10 upgrade stones for waiting 24 hours? That seems a bit broken. Especially when the heroes get up to a higher level and you have 5 star heroes that require like 800 stones to upgrade any more.
